title: cleistanthus vidalii
intro: Cleistanthus vidalii, commonly known as the Indian Spurge or Vidal's Cleistanthus, is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleistanthus vidalii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit hepatoprotective and cardioprotective effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the primary compounds contributing to its medicinal value.
